definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is easy to talk to, unpretentious, and makes others feel comfortable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{気|き}さくな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: The company president is a very approachable person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}さく⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけて→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: She spoke to me in a friendly manner.

examples.japanese: {気|き}さくな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{仲良|なかよ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧⟦なれる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: With his friendly personality, he can quickly become friends with anyone.

notes:
FORMS:
- {気|き}さくな + noun - friendly (modifier)
- {気|き}さく⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb - in a friendly manner (adverb)

USAGE:
Describes someone who doesn't put on airs and is easy to approach despite their status. Often used positively about people in higher positions (bosses, celebrities) who are down-to-earth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気|き}さくな⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧ - friendly personality
- {気|き}さく⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ - to talk in a friendly way
- {気|き}さく⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧ - to respond amiably

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フレンドリー - friendly (loanword)
- ⟦{親|した}しみやすい→親しみやすい：19142_shitashimiyasui⟧ - approachable
- ⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧ - casual, lighthearted
- ⟦{気前|きまえ}がいい→気前がいい：20378_kimaegaii⟧ - generous
